subject: Science
stem: Kwashiorkor, a deficiency disease common in young children, is caused mainly by a severe lack of:
explanation: Kwashiorkor results from severe protein deficiency (despite sometimes adequate calories), causing swelling (oedema), stunted growth and a distended belly. Vitamin C deficiency causes scurvy; iodine deficiency causes goitre.

section: Science · Ch40 — Food, Health & Nutrition — Deep Practice
subject: Science
stem: Goitre, a swelling of the neck caused by an enlarged thyroid gland, results from deficiency of:
explanation: Iodine deficiency impairs thyroid hormone production, causing the gland to enlarge (goitre). This is why iodised salt is promoted for public health. Iron deficiency causes anaemia instead.

section: Science · Ch40 — Food, Health & Nutrition — Deep Practice
subject: Science
stem: Vaccination protects children from certain diseases by:

options.option_text: Stimulating the body's immune system to produce antibodies against a specific pathogen
Directly killing the pathogen already present in the body
Providing extra vitamins to the child
Physically blocking pathogens from entering the body

explanation: Vaccines introduce a weakened/inactive form of a pathogen (or its components) to trigger the immune system to produce antibodies, giving future protection — a preventive mechanism, not a direct treatment.

section: Science · Ch40 — Food, Health & Nutrition — Deep Practice
subject: Science
stem: The digestion of starch begins in the mouth due to the action of which enzyme present in saliva?
explanation: Salivary amylase breaks down starch into simpler sugars, beginning digestion in the mouth. Pepsin (stomach) and trypsin (small intestine) digest proteins; lipase digests fats.
